notes: §18.2.1: "`world.rand` is a CSPRNG … It provides `rand.int(0..10)`, `rand.token(bytes: 32) -> Secret[String]` and `rand.uuid_v4()`. `Rand.seeded(n)` is a deterministic PRNG … It needs no capability and **has no `token` or `uuid` methods**, so using it for secrets is a type error by omission (04 S7)." The "type error by omission" is an unknown method: §21.3 "an unknown method is K0420".
